units.source_text: 这年梅雨季节已过，雨还是阴郁地下个不停。

en.t: That year, although the rainy season had already passed, the rain still kept falling gloomily.
Summer, too, was slow in coming.

units.source_text: 七月二十日大暑前十几天，骤然酷热起来。

en.t: On July twentieth, more than ten days before Great Heat, it suddenly turned intensely hot.

units.source_text: 二十一日，薄霭阴沉地笼罩着明星岳。

en.t: On the twenty-first, a thin haze hung darkly over Myojogatake.

units.source_text: 廊道边上的卷丹花招来了黑凤蝶，令人感到一股闷热。

en.t: The tiger lilies beside the corridor drew black swallowtail butterflies, making the heat feel close and stifling.

units.source_text: 卷丹花的一根茎上竟绽开了十五朵花。

en.t: On a single stem of tiger lily, as many as fifteen blossoms had opened.

units.source_text: 庭院里百鸟齐鸣，也使人感到闷热。

en.t: In the garden, countless birds cried out together, and that too made the air feel oppressive.

units.source_text: 连担任记录的少女也扇起扇子来。

en.t: Even the girl serving as recorder began to fan herself.

units.source_text: 这场棋赛第一次遇上这般酷热的天气。

en.t: For the first time, this go match had encountered weather of such fierce heat.
